Daily Journal

Write dated journal entries, search them, and keep them saved in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. The date picker defaults to today — change it to write for another day.
  2. Give the entry a title, write your thoughts, and click Save Entry.
  3. Search past entries with the search box; click an entry to load it for editing.
  4. Delete an entry you no longer want with the Delete button.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where are my entries stored?

Entries are stored in your browser's localStorage on this device. They never leave your computer — there is no server involved.

How does search work?

The search box matches text in the entry title and body. Entries are sorted newest-first.

How do I edit an old entry?

The date picker defaults to today. Click any date in the entry list to load it for editing.

Can I export or delete entries?

Use your browser's export to save entries, or clear them with the delete button. Back up anything important elsewhere.
